name: @dashforge/blueprint-node
description: Server SDK for Blueprint contracts (Node/TypeScript). Load a published contract, resolve its dynamic items, fill field defaults, validate, and serve it. Agnostic (validates against the frozen contract-v1 JSON Schema) and eval-free (PCI/CSP-safe).

scripts.gen:types: json2ts schema/contract-v1.schema.json --output src/contract.generated.ts --bannerComment "/* GENERATED from schema/contract-v1.schema.json — do not edit. */"
